events.title: 26.10.19 Patch Notes
events.summary: 26.10.19 Patch NotesBalance AdjustmentsIncreased the effect of the first movement speed skill.Movement Speed 1: +50% → +80%Enemies that spawn after an enemy is defeated now appear at random locations on the map instead of where that enemy was defeated.As fewer enemies remain, the next wave starts sooner, reducing downtime between fights.Does not apply to boss fights.

events.title: Demo Patch Notes — October 11, 2026
events.summary: Demo Patch Notes — October 11, 2026Quality of Life (QoL) ImprovementsOne-Click Level Selection: Levels can now be started with a single click.Altar Health Bar: Added a health bar that appears when attacking a Boss Altar.Meteor Impact Indicator: Added a visual indicator that highlights the area where a meteor will land.Meteor Ready Indicator: An icon now appears above the player when Meteor is ready to cast. Added an audio cue for Manual Cast mode.Soul Collection VFX: Defeated enemies now release

events.title: The Pray & Slay demo is out!
events.summary: Hey everyone! You can now try the Pray & Slay demo. We’d love to hear what you think! Try the demo Anything you’d like to share is welcome — what you enjoyed, what felt confusing, or something you’d change. Leave a comment below or come chat with us on Discord. Your feedback helps us make the game better. Thanks for giving it a go! Atonal Games

events.title: Pray & Slay demo trailer is here — demo coming soon!

We’re putting on the finishing touches before sharing it with you. We’re aiming to release the demo on Steam next week, October 5–11. The exact release day is still to be confirmed.
